summary.text: The revised page renames its title, adds a Termination section and changes two amounts and a delivery date.

changes.explanation: The page title changes from Service Agreement | Example to Service Agreement (2026 revision) | Example.
changes.why_it_may_matter: Impact could not be determined from the documents.

changes.explanation: A new heading, Termination, is added to the Service Agreement.
changes.why_it_may_matter: This adds a new section a reader may want to review.

changes.explanation: In the Pricing section, the amount changes from 50,000 to 75,000, an increase of 25,000.
In the Delivery section, the date changes from 30 June 2026 to 15 July 2026, 15 days later.
changes.why_it_may_matter: This may move a delivery date.

changes.explanation: The Termination section adds: Either party may terminate with sixty days notice.
changes.why_it_may_matter: This adds a condition on ending the agreement.

changes.explanation: In the Resources section, the number changes from 90,000 to 95,000.
